title: NNSA passes 54 publication-review receipt cases
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy and National Nuclear Security Administration
summary: 18 decision-specific receipt fixtures validate, while 36 incompatible-reason or mutated-attribution fixtures are rejected. Denominator: 54 cases across six publication decisions and 3 contracts; zero actual publication receipts.
